g.text: A view showing a 50,000-item buffer (the browser scrolls it natively)

text.tspan: the spacers make its range the whole buffer,
so its thumb sits about halfway
The page reports how far the top edge is
from the nearest drawn item; Tuna counts items
from there by the same average, makes the item
there the scroll state, and draws around it
about two view heights, as the browser measured
scroll state = item 25,000, 8 px above the top edge
about two view heights, as the browser measured
at the same 25 px each, empty

g.text: a drag or fling lands in a spacer
